02 / THE TOOLKIT

A small studio.
A complete practice.

Use the skill for editorial judgment.
Add the local application for production.

A

The editorial skill

Instructions and references that guide Codex through planning, editing, brand development, photography storytelling and whole-issue review.

  • Editorial promise, story mix & flatplan
  • Reusable brand sheet & issue variations
  • Headlines, captions & evidence checks
  • Design proofs & layout readback
Install in Codex ↗
B

The local dashboard

A separate Python application for organising features, reviewing images and exporting PDFs. Runs on your own device.

  • Two baseline visual themes
  • Image provenance & exact-asset approval
  • PDF progress indicator & estimated time
  • Preflight, image & hyperlink audits
Set up the dashboard ↗
THE CURRENT CANVAS

A4 portrait. Up to 12 magazine feature pages or 3 onepager features. RGB PDF output. High-end custom proof spreads are a separate, explicitly approved phase. No claim of CMYK, bleed or press-ready certification.

PUBLIC SOURCE / v0.4.0

Choose one
installation route.

The skill adds instructions and references. It does not install Python dependencies or a hosted application.

Open GitHub repository ↗

The skill runs locally in Codex. Installing it does not upload your publications or photos.

  1. Open Codex

    Use the bundled Skill Installer with the prompt below. The source is public; no GitHub invitation or private-repository token is required for the standard download.

  2. Paste this into Codex

    $skill-installer install https://github.com/hndrk-020/editorial-studio/tree/main/.agents/skills/editorial-studio

    The bundled installer normally uses ~/.codex/skills. It refuses to overwrite an existing skill folder; back up local edits before a deliberate update.

  3. Check that Codex can load it

    Start a new turn; restart Codex if needed. Use the verification prompt below and check the reported skill path.

  1. Download and extract the source

    Open the public repository, choose Code → Download ZIP on main, then Extract All. Do not run scripts inside the ZIP preview.

  2. Run the installer

    Double-click install_codex_skill_windows.cmd. It copies the full skill to %USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\editorial-studio. No administrator access or Python is needed for this copy.

    Existing installation? Back it up before approving replacement. The script overlays files; it does not remove obsolete files.

  3. Verify the files and discovery

    Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.agents\skills\editorial-studio\SKILL.md"

    Run this in PowerShell. Expect True, then start a new Codex turn and use the prompt below to verify loading.

VERIFY THE SKILL
$editorial-studio Confirm you can load the skill and its editorial planning and brand system references. Tell me the loaded SKILL.md path. Do not start a publication yet.
Optional / Start the local dashboard+

Keep the complete repository and install Python 3.11 or newer. The first launch requires internet to install dependencies.

Windows

Double-click run_windows.cmd in the extracted repository.

macOS & Linux

chmod +x run_mac_linux.sh && ./run_mac_linux.sh

Open http://127.0.0.1:8765. Keep the terminal running; Ctrl+C stops the application. Keep it on localhost. Your publication files and exports remain local unless you choose to share them.

Already installed? Update without losing local edits.+

Keep one intended user-wide copy. The Windows installer uses ~/.agents/skills; the bundled Skill Installer normally uses ~/.codex/skills. A project-local copy can also exist. Ask Codex for the loaded path before changing anything.

Back up the whole existing skill folder outside active skill directories. Update the complete folder, including references. Preserve local changes and verify loading again.

04 / YOUR FIRST BRIEF

Bring a subject.
Keep your point of view.

$editorial-studio Create a photography-led architecture onepager for design readers. Start with the purpose, audience and style. Ask for an inspiration URL or no example, then show two distinct creative directions before production.

Expect a conversation before a layout. You approve the direction and exact images. The final PDF still needs a visual review.

BUILT WITH BOUNDARIES

Real sources.
Explicit approvals.

Photography is researched and reviewed by a person. Provenance and rights evidence are recorded; approval fields do not prove a licence. Missing or unapproved images block export.

Reviewed.
Still accountable.

Release 0.4.0 passed 41 regression tests on Windows and Linux, with Python 3.11 and 3.13. A dependency scan found no known vulnerabilities at review time. This is not a security certification.
